title: Sample fixation and RNA extraction for metatranscriptomics sequencing
author: Apoorva Prabhu
materials: Use equipment such as filters, filtration towers and lines in the fume hood, for RNA purposes only. Wipe down all surfaces with 70% Ethanol, and use Alfoil (Aluminium foil) to cover working area (taped down). Use RNase Zap ‱ RNase Decontamination Solution to wipe down all surfaces.

Buffer Sigma Phenol from pH 4 to pH 6.9 using a pH meter and kit-supplied pH 10 concentrate.Around ~500ul of this concentrate is usually added to 60ml of 0.1M Citrate buffered phenol to reach pH 6.9 using a pH meter. Note : If this phenol is unavailable, an alternate can be prepared from 0.1M Citrate buffered phenol (Merck, USA) which includes a pH 10 concentrated solution.

Reagents: Phenol - Sigma P4557 pH6.9 Ethanol 10% Hydrochloric Acid 10% SDS Liquid N 2 RNase Zap ‱ RNase Decontamination Solution - Thermofisher AM9780 Sampling equipment: Acid-washed carboys/containers, pre-marked to 3.6L and 4L Sampling bucket Merck filtration towers Merck 8um pre-filter 147mm Merck 0.22um Sterivex filter - SVGP01050 Parafilm Whirlpak Bags Ice bricks Kits : Purelink‱ RNA Mini Kit - Thermofisher 12183018A TURBO DNA- free ‱ Kit - AM1907 2ml/1.5ml Eppendorf/RNase-free tubes

steps.title: Prepare Decontamination Area
steps.instruction: Wipe down the vortex mixer, centrifuge, and tube racks with 70% ethanol and RNase Zap RNase Decontamination Solution and place them on the Alfoil area.

steps.title: Prepare Phenol-Ethanol Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 400ml of 5% aqueous phenol in ethanol solution in a dark glass bottle or a bottle wrapped in aluminium foil.

substeps.instruction: Pour 380ml of 100% ethanol into the bottle.
Slowly pipette 20ml pH 6.9 phenol along the sides of the bottle, ensuring phenol is drawn from below the buffer layer.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Collection Containers
steps.instruction: Pre-wash sample collection containers with 10% Hydrochloric acid, followed by distilled water 3 times.

steps.title: Collect Water Samples
steps.instruction: Collect estuary water using a sample collection bucket, filling the containers up to the pre-marked 3.6L line.

steps.title: Fix Samples with Phenol Solution
steps.instruction: Carefully add 400ml of the prepared 5% aqueous phenol in ethanol solution to the containers without spilling.

substeps.instruction: Place bottles into a large esky in the dark, filled with ice bricks to keep the solution cool during sampling.

steps.title: Set Up Filtration System
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, assemble the filtration apparatus using a peristaltic pump (Masterflex, USA).

substeps.instruction: Connect 18 gauge tubing to the pump, with 24 inch tubing inserted into the phenol-fixed sample.
Connect the other end to 142 mm Merck Filtration Towers fitted with 8um pre-filters.
Connect the towers to a 0.22um Sterivex filter (SVGP1050H).
Connect tubing from the other end of the Sterivex filter to a drain sink.

steps.title: Filter Samples
steps.instruction: Run the peristaltic pump (Masterflex, USA) at 100rpm for approximately 20-30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Monitor carefully for leaks.
Ensure all water is dispensed from the Sterivex filter without allowing it to dry.
Maintain pressure under 30 psi.

steps.title: Store Filters
steps.instruction: Seal and freeze the Sterivex filters.

substeps.instruction: Plug the Sterivex filter using parafilm or Sterivex caps.
Place filters in Whirl-Pak Bags.
Snap-freeze in liquid N2.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Prepare the elution buffer and defrost the filter.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat the kit's Elution buffer in heat blocks set to 72°C.
Defrost the Sterivex filter in the fume hood for 1-2 minutes.
Remove parafilm/caps from one end, keeping the other end tightly sealed.

steps.title: Lyse Cells in Filter
steps.instruction: Apply lysis reagents to the Sterivex filter and agitate.

substeps.instruction: Add 900ul of kit lysis buffer.
Slowly add 100ul of 10% SDS along the sides of the filter.
Place on a vortex shaker at maximum speed for 15 minutes.
Rotate the filter 180 degrees and shake for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Extract Lysis Mixture
steps.instruction: Recover the buffer + SDS mixture from the filter using a 3ml syringe.

substeps.instruction: Draw air into the syringe and attach to the Sterivex filter luer-lock.
Slowly push air into the filter with minimal bubbling to force the buffer mixture into the syringe.
Transfer the mixture into sterile 2ml tubes.
Add an equal volume of 100% Ethanol and mix well.

steps.title: Purify RNA via Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto a kit spin column and wash.

substeps.instruction: Load 300ul of the buffer + SDS mixture into the spin column and spin at 16,000g for 15 seconds (do not exceed 300ul per load).
Repeat loading up to 2 times before dispensing flow-through; repeat until all mixture is processed.
Load 180ul of Wash Solution I and spin at 15,000g for 15 seconds.
Load 180ul of Wash Solution II/III and spin at 15,000g for 15 seconds.
Load 180ul of Wash Solution II/III again and spin at 15,000g for 15 seconds.
Dry spin the column at 16,100g for 1 minute.
Replace the collection tube with a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA using pre-warmed Elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Quickly add 11ul of pre-warmed Elution buffer to the center of the column.
Stand for 1 minute at room temperature, then spin at 15,000g for 30 seconds.
Repeat the process with a second addition of 11ul of pre-warmed Elution buffer (1 min stand, 15,000g spin for 30 seconds).
Discard the spin column and immediately place RNA samples on an ice rack.

steps.title: Perform DNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Treat the RNA sample with Turbo DNAse I.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ul of 10X Turbo DNAse I buffer and 1ul of Turbo DNAse I along the sides of the tube.
Mix gently using a vortex shaker and spin down.
Incubate in a shaking incubator for 40 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Inactivate DNAse and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Stop the DNAse reaction and recover the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.3ul of DNase Inactivation Reagent and mix thoroughly by vortexing.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,100g for 1 minute to pellet the Inactivation Reagent (repeat spin if needed).
Transfer the supernatant (approx. 20ul of RNA sample) into a fresh RNase-free tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA using RNA TapeStation or Qubit (typical yield: 0.5 - 2ug, RIN: 7 - 9).
